name: @habemus-papadum/aiui-slides
description: The slides framework: a deck of viewport-sized, scroll-snapped slides as an ordinary aiui app — current slide as a control, HUD grid overview with live previews, widget-first navigation over a modal-kit keymap, and the Lens (hover preview → interactive detail overlay, folded into the page's reactive graph). Internal, never published; consumed by workspace demos and by out-of-repo apps via link: (design contract: docs/proposals/slides.md).
